hook.text_top: She never takes the lollipop out.
hook.voice: She never takes the lollipop out.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off side-profile medium close-up: a high kick sweeps past her face; she flicks her hand and a burst of icy water blasts the bully onto the crash mat.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A locked side profile. She barely moves her head, then one flick of the hand sends the bully flying.

shots.excerpt: Wide side shot of the rooftop: she touches the floor with one fingertip. MUST SHOW: a square patch of glossy black ice with white cracks spreads out.
highlight: glossy black ice with white cracks
shots.voice: Shot 2. A wide side shot. One fingertip on the floor spreads a patch of black ice, and the bully slips.

shots.excerpt: Frontal close-up, slightly low angle: the pole stops at her eyes. MUST SHOW: the metal pole freezes into clear crystal ice from the tip back, then shatters.
shots.voice: Shot 3. A frontal close-up. She just points, and the metal pole freezes into crystal and shatters at the lens.

shots.excerpt: Medium-wide front shot: the bully chops down with a shovel. MUST SHOW: a thick glittering pillar of ice shoots up and launches her out of the top of the shot.
highlight: out of the top of the shot
shots.voice: Shot 5. A pillar of ice grows taller than the frame and launches the bully straight out of the shot.

shots.excerpt: Slow gentle push-in: two huge jagged slabs of clear ice trap the last bully in a triangle, then explode into a giant spray of glittering shards.
shots.voice: Shot 6. A slow push-in for the finale. Two ice walls trap the last bully and explode into shards.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
